messages.subject: dChip import
parts:
Hi, I'm trying to import some CEL files (output from .dcp files from
dChip) following along from this:
http://groups.google.com/group/aroma-affymetrix/web/import-from-dchip

My output:

> path<-"rawData/CNV/Mapping50K_Hind240"
> cs <- AffymetrixCelSet$importFromDChip(path)
Error in .unwrapDatHeaderString(header$DatHeader) :
Internal error: Failed to extract 'pixelRange' and 'sampleName' from
DAT header. They became identical: 19299(176)

Any thoughts? "19299(176),Hind240.cel" is the first file in
Mapping50K_Hind240.

messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Re: dChip import
parts:
Hi,

the error is generated internally by the affxparser package. It may
have to do with the fact that you have parentheses in your filename,
but I'm not sure. Have you tried with files without parentheses.

Please report your sessionInfo() and the output of traceback() after
you get the error.

/Henrik
